description: Small synthetic software and mathematics corpus with manually authored relevance labels. Not a real-user or real-model benchmark.

documents.title: SQL transaction notes
documents.text: A database transaction commits all changes atomically. Isolation controls how concurrent transactions observe intermediate changes.

documents.title: Queue notes
documents.text: A bounded queue provides backpressure for producers. A semaphore limits the number of concurrent tasks.

documents.title: Calculus notes
documents.text: A derivative measures the instantaneous rate of change of a function. The derivative gives the slope of the tangent line.

documents.title: 缓存笔记
documents.text: 缓存使用过期时间 TTL 控制失效。缓存过期后重新读取数据库，避免长期使用陈旧数据。

documents.title: 并发笔记
documents.text: 信号量用于限制同时执行的任务数量。并发闸门可防止无限制启动任务，保护下游服务。

documents.title: RPC notes
documents.text: gRPC uses Protocol Buffers to define service methods and message types. A deadline bounds how long an RPC may execute.

documents.title: Cancellation notes
documents.text: An AbortController signals cancellation to a pending fetch request. Late responses must be discarded when the active account changes.

documents.title: 引用笔记
documents.text: 引用校验需要核对文档标识、片段标识、页码和连续原文。原文存在并不代表回答的语义推论一定正确。
